body: codex-storyatlas-root, one concrete bridge from that principle to the current work: P1-3's segment structural match is now a typed StructuralReduction, not just a scalar. Its receipt retains the reducer, canonical member ids, every per-member Estimate (including provider abstention), incompatible-member exclusions with contradiction facets, source-chart coverage, and observed-estimate coverage. An absent chart or abstention cannot be painted in as 0.5 and disappear into the score. The Atlas/Codex renderer can project the scalar, but the selected mark can descend to the exact receipt and source members. That is the same 'aggregate is an artifact, heatmap is a view' rule at the local-cost scale.
